name: Whisper Beneath the Waves
desc: You discover a strange tree at the Eye of Kratti...

customize.text:
<color=#ece5d8>Eye of Kratti, Nod-Krai</color>
<color=#ffffff>Quest Description:</color> <color=#ffffff>You discover a strange tree at the Eye of Kratti...</color>
Quest Objective: Talk to Paimon
Optional Dialogue: Talk to Ilmari
<color=#ffffff>Ilmari:</color> Another day, another empty bucket.
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: What are you doing here?</color>
<color=#ffffff>Ilmari:</color> Fishing. Though so far, I've only caught things that aren't fish.
<color=#ffffff>Ilmari:</color> If it were knick-knacks from shipwrecks, that'd be fine, 'cause traveling merchants would buy those. I once pulled up a boot with half a... *sigh* Forget it. Talking about stuff like that will scare the fish off.
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: Is there anything of note nearby?</color>
<color=#ffffff>Ilmari:</color> Treasure hunting, huh? That "Great Treasure" they say lies east of the moon and west of the sun... Doesn't take much to know this isn't the place to find it.
<color=#ffffff>Ilmari:</color> Though saying that, there've been a good few shipwrecks in these waters. There may well be treasure beneath the waves, not that you'd find it easy to get at.
<color=#ffffff>Ilmari:</color> I heard talk at the tavern, too, from sailors who escaped their sinking ship. Said it happened on a moonless night, yet something was glowing among the towering waves.
<color=#ffffff>Ilmari:</color> They swore it was one-eyed Kratti, a monster that could swallow the moon. It was fighting a giant sea serpent for the right to rule its territory.
<color=#ffffff>Ilmari:</color> For a long time after that, this whole stretch of ocean stayed as dark as ink. No ships dared pass through — they all feared the lost souls beneath the waves would drag them down.
<color=#ffffff>Ilmari:</color> People claim those lost souls still wander nearby, but I say it's all just stories meant to frighten kids. I don't buy that nonsense.
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: About this tree...</color>
<color=#ffffff>Ilmari:</color> It's cursed. There used to be a whirlpool here — the sailors called it the Eye of Kratti. Then one day, this tree just started growing right out of it.
<color=#ffffff>Ilmari:</color> And that wasn't the only strange thing that happened around that time. Tracing it back, it all started with those rocks falling from the sky... Who knows? Maybe this tree's from the same place.
<color=#ffffff>Ilmari:</color> Then there are those little shiny things that appear every now and then, rare as you like, those are. I figured there might be new kinds of fish, too. That's why I came out here — to try my luck.
<color=#ffffff>Ilmari:</color> I used to have a fishing buddy who came out here, too, but he said he kept hearing strange singing. It spooked him so bad, he never came back. Hah, only half a Frostmoon Scion that one, but he inherited every one of their odd little habits.
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: Sorry to bother you.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Ilmari:</color> No worries. There's not a single fish in sight anyway.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Traveler, do you feel okay? Paimon's getting a little dizzy over here...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Huh... Paimon thinks she just heard someone talking...
Quest Objective: Continue exploring
<color=#ffffff>Strange Lady:</color> "Mama's in the sheepfold, don't be scared, don't be worried..."
<color=#ffffff>Strange Lady:</color> "Take my tattered cloak — dance now, don't stop..."
<color=#ffffff>Strange Lady:</color> Salme! Salomea! Where are you?!
<color=#ffffff>Strange Lady:</color> Salme, please... Say something! I'm so worried...
<color=#ffffff>Strange Lady:</color> How could this be...? It's like she's a totally different person...
<color=#ffffff>Strange Lady:</color> She... She's become a monster...
Quest Objective: Continue exploring the cave
Quest Objective: Talk to Paimon
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Wow... There's a bunch of those shiny little things we saw earlier! Wait, where are we, anyway?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Could it be we've circled round to right under that weird tree? And those green things... what even are they?
Quest Objective: Find a way to collect Kuuvahki Dewdrops and throw them into the central energy field
Quest Objective: Return to the surface
Optional Dialogue: Talk to Ilmari
<color=#ffffff>Ilmari:</color> How strange... How very strange...
Quest Objective: Talk to Ilmari
<color=#ffffff>Ilmari:</color> Now that's strange...
<color=#ffffff>Ilmari:</color> Did you see that? The tree just lit up all of a sudden, and these little things... Too bad they're not fish.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> So that thing in the center must be its root, huh? Paimon doesn't understand how it works, but now that it's all shiny, it looks way better than when it was dull.
<color=#ffffff>You explain what happened earlier...</color>
<color=#ffffff>Ilmari:</color> It's pretty hard to believe... But you've got no reason to spin me a yarn. Looks like that fishing buddy of mine, that half-Frostmoon Scion, was right after all.
<color=#ffffff>Ilmari:</color> But so what? They're just remnants of the past. Whatever they sing or say, it's not gonna stop us living folks from catching living fish.
<color=#ffffff>Ilmari:</color> Anyway, you folks are treasure hunters, aren't you? That thing you picked up earlier...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> This is the Proof of the Cognoscenti? It looks like an ordinary feather...
<color=#ffffff>Ilmari:</color> A trader I know once said that if you collect five Proofs of the Cognoscenti, you'll uncover that "Great Treasure" east of the moon and west of the sun. Who knows if it's true?
<color=#ffffff>Ilmari:</color> Still, a lot of treasure hunters seem to believe the stories. They're all rushing after it like crazy.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Well, it's treasure, after all! If you ask Paimon, she's kinda curious too.
<color=#ffffff>Ilmari:</color> If I were 20 years younger... Nah, even then, I'd still be out here fishing. That said, another day, another empty bucket...

customize.text: Unlock Requirements

Enter a hole at the east coast of <color=#ece5d8>Eye of Kratti</color> .
<color=#ffffff>Location -</color> <color=#ece5d8>Eye of Kratti, Nod-Krai</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Teleport to the nearby waypoint and approach the quest location circled in red.</color>

<color=#ffffff73>The player will see some ghosts talk about a Proof of Cognoscenti near some debris with a red kuuvahki field on them.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Use a nearby kuuvahki stone to destroy the debris, then enter the hole that was formed.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective:</color> <color=#ffffff73>Talk to Paimon</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective:</color> <color=#ffffff73>Continue exploring</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective:</color> <color=#ffffff73>Continue exploring the cave</color>

<color=#ffffff73>To start the quest, enter the hole.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>The player will see a ghost going further in.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Kuuvahki can be utilized to open the path.</color>

<color=#ffffff73>In this quest, the player will come across some points of interest which the player must touch.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>From them will emerge creatures that will help the player progress.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Take the nearby Kuuvahki Dewdrop and energize the gate to open a path.</color>

<color=#ffffff73>Here, the player must take the nearby Kuuvahki Dewdrop forward.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Do not touch the kuuvahki energy fields or the Kuuvahki Dewdrop will be sent back.</color>

<color=#ffffff73>Reaching the gate, use the Kuuvahki Dewdrop to open it.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective:</color> <color=#ffffff73>Talk to Paimon</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective:</color> <color=#ffffff73>Find a way to collect Kuuvahki Dewdrops and throw them into the central energy field</color>

<color=#ffffff73>Use the Moonlanes to navigate the area.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>The Kuuvahki Dewdrops will form in each of the three pillars present here.</color>

<color=#ffffff73>In order to progress, touch the same types of point of interest seen earlier.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Creatures will emerge from them, and once a sufficient number has been joined in one of the three pillars, they will form a Kuuvahki Dewdrop.</color>

<color=#ffffff73>The central energy field must be fed three Kuuvahki Dewdrops in order to progress the quest.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective:</color> <color=#ffffff73>Return to the surface</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective:</color> <color=#ffffff73>Talk to Ilmari</color>

<color=#ffffff73>Returning to the surface, interact with the Exquisite Chest in the middle of the water to progress.</color>
